svg.title: How the VibeSplit balance sheet adds up
svg.desc: Worked example of the rule in BalanceSheet.js. A canteen run with four people: Vada pav 120 rupees paid by Asha and split four ways, chai 60 rupees paid by Bilal and split between Asha, Bilal and Chirag, cold coffee 200 rupees paid by Chirag and split four ways. For each expense the payer gets plus the amount and everyone in the split gets minus the amount divided by the number of people in the split. Final balances: Asha gets back 20, Bilal owes 40, Chirag gets back 100, Dev owes 80. The balances sum to zero.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
